name: Model Migration Master Prompt 🔄
description_md:
# What You Get

- A refined master prompt that instantly compares any two AI models and gives you a step-by-step migration guide.

- Built-in workflow covering key differences, prompt restructuring, formatting tweaks, and common pitfalls to avoid.

- Real before-and-after examples plus a simple find-and-replace “converter” so you can update prompts in minutes.

- Optional section to paste your own prompt and get a personalized conversion for the new model.
